diagnosis: The view dynamically sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin using an unanchored regex matching any origin containing 'company.com' (such as 'attackercompany.com') while enabling Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true. Simultaneously, the get() method retrieves EmployeePayrollRecord by URL parameter employee_id without verifying that the authenticated caller matches employee_id or is an HR admin. An attacker hosting a malicious site on attackercompany.com can initiate credentialed cross-origin requests to steal any employee's salary and banking details.
exploit_request:
GET /api/hr/payroll/EMP-90214/ HTTP/1.1
Host: payroll.internal.company.com
Origin: https://attackercompany.com
Cookie: sessionid=valid_authenticated_employee_session
Accept: application/json
